text:
ashley: Quick scrub of the RCA action snaglist — dropping current owners/dates. Please confirm or reassign and call out blockers. I want this closed by EOW if feasible.

ashley: Action list (from postmortem):
```
1) Investigate request routing fallback (owner: diego) — due 2026-03-26
2) Add extra metrics for KV cache misses (owner: samir) — due 2026-03-24
3) Harden fallback model variant auth (owner: maria) — due 2026-03-28
4) Deploy rollback guard for canary (owner: kevin) — due 2026-03-25
5) Update runbook + run through (owner: ashley) — due 2026-03-27
```

diego: I can own #1 but need clarity — is this only the routing policy code in runtime or also the router config in infra?

ashley: Good q — both. Runtime change + infra rule to prefer region-local pools. I'll add infra ticket link in a sec.

ashley: infra ticket: https://redwood/infra/INC-5123 (blocks #1)

samir: Ack on #2, working on the metric tags now. ETA 3/24 looks OK unless we find perf regressions during trace sampling.

maria: Re: #3 — blocked by security review for token forwarding. Security needs the threat model doc. @kevin can you help with the threat model write-up?

kevin: Yep I can take the threat model draft. I can have a first pass by Tue (2026-03-23). After that, maria, can you schedule the sec review?

maria: Yes I'll book the review for Wed morning. Thanks @kevin :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Deploy notification — canary started for service inference-runtime at 2026-03-21T14:02Z (sha: c3f9b1). No errors seen in first 5m.

kevin: For #4, I need one extra hour with SRE on the rollback guard tests. Can we slip the due date to 3/26?

ashley: We can move #4 to 3/26 if the rollback guard depends on the infra alerting change that Diego is doing. Diego, if your infra change is on the critical path, call it out.

 diego: The infra rule change is a separate merge but needs a small ACL change from security. That might add a day. So timeline: runtime patch asap, infra ACL update by 3/25. If so, Kevin's 3/26 is fine.

samir: Quick note: adding the KV cache metrics will require a lightweight proto change. I'll include a compatibility flag so it can be rolled out without full client bump.

ashley: Sweet. Reassignments / confirmed owners so far: #1 diego (depends INC-5123 + sec ACL), #2 samir (3/24), #3 maria (sec review Wed) + kevin threat model (3/23), #4 kevin (3/26), #5 ashley (3/27).

maria: I'll mark the sec ACL as blocker in the ticket and ping sec.

kevin: pinged sec already in DM. Will post update here once they ack.

ashley: Final ask — if you can't meet your date, reply here with new ETA and reason. I'm doing a short checkpoint Fri 10am to close outstanding items.

samir: noted. If perf sampling spikes, I may request one-day extension. Will update by Thu.

diego: I'll post a short runbook snippet on what to test for the routing fallback once runtime change is ready.

maria: Sec review slot confirmed Wed 10:30-11. Adding calendar invite and runbook link.

ashley: Thanks all. Marking this thread for EOW sweep. :white_check_mark:
